ja374:1.1: Sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ samādāya pāraṃ tiṇṇo si brāhmaṇa, pacchā gaccha lahuṃ, khippaṃ mam pi tārehi dān' ito ti.
ja374:2.1: Asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena (Cfr. supra p. 63.) niminni bhotī adhuvaṃ dhuvena, mayāpi bhotī nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan ti.
ja374:3.1: Kāyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe karoti ahuhāliyaṃ, na-y-idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā tālaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhakāle sussoṇi kin nu jagghasi sobhaṇe ti.
ja374:4.1: Sigāla bāla dummedha appapañño si jambuka, jīno macchañ ca pesiñ ca kapaṇo viya jhāyasīti.
ja374:5.1: Sudassaṃ vajjaṃ aññesaṃ attano pana duddasaṃ, jīnā patiñ ca jārañ ca tvam pi maññe va jhāyasīti.
ja374:6.1: Evam etaṃ migarāja yathā bhāsasi jambuka, sā nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā bhattu hessaṃ vasānugā ti
ja374:7.1: Yo hare mattikāthālaṃ kaṃsathālam pi so hare, kataṃ yeva tayā pāpaṃ puna p' evaṃ karissasīti.
